result.title: FrameForge: Harnessing Priors of Video Foundation Models for Unified Image Generation
result.summary: Unified conditional image generation requires a single model to preserve different aspects of a visual input while producing a target image that follows textual guidance. Pretrained video models provide a promising foundation by encoding visual transformations across time, yet existing approaches typically assign the condition and target to fixed temporal positions. We observe that condition-target relationships vary substantially across generation tasks, while video models naturally encode visual transformations at different temporal scales. This motivates us to model conditional generation through input-adaptive virtual temporal relations. We propose FrameForge, which captures two complementary aspects of such relations. Mixture of Temporal Experts (MoTE) models how far the target lies from the condition by dynamically selecting temporal RoPE experts with different virtual intervals. Chain of Temporal Reasoning (CoTR) models how the condition is transformed into the target through a latent intermediate state, with a reasoning-bottleneck attention mask encouraging information propagation through this pathway. Experiments on DreamBench, COCO2017, and GEdit-Bench show that FrameForge achieves superior performance in subject-driven generation, canny-to-image generation, and image editing among the compared methods.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 FrameForge，借用视频基础模型的时间变换先验做统一条件图像生成：用 Mixture of Temporal Experts 动态选择不同虚拟时间间隔的 RoPE 专家，并用 Chain of Temporal Reasoning 通过 latent 中间状态与推理瓶颈注意力掩码刻画条件到目标的变换。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 latent 中间状态加瓶颈注意力掩码的传递路径，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理状态如何承载并压缩任务必要信息、以及信息坍缩风险；但任务本身是图像生成，与 VLM 推理仅有间接方法联系。
